4011101.Name: Cosmic Crystal
4011101.Description: A luxurious crystal crafted exclusively for royalty. Each inch is carefully polished to sparkle like the dazzling stars in the night sky.

4011102.Name: Forest Heartling
4011102.Description: Once rooted in the Dark Forest, this young tree never grew into a towering giant but continues to live in another form.

4011103.Name: Beastcaller Bell
4011103.Description: Forged by the skilled hands of a dwarven blacksmith, each crisp chime carries mysterious power, guiding beasts along a designated path.

4011104.Name: Midnight Vine
4011104.Description: Native to the Bantus Empire, this mystical plant grows in darkness, defying decay. It emits a faint glow in the dark, making it ideal for weaving durable textiles.

4011105.Name: Eternal Frost
4011105.Description: Legend holds that it is the frost scattered by Alna, found atop the Sacred Mountains. Unyielding to time, it remains frozen and unmelting.

4011106.Name: Inferno Core
4011106.Description: Born from volcanic magma, its inner heat radiates outward, blazing fiercely yet gentle to the touch—an everlasting flame at its core.

4011107.Name: Lunar Strings
4011107.Description: Designed for harpists in pursuit of the perfect sound, these strings deliver a pristine, elegant tone that brings melodies to life.
